comparisons.reason: Index 0 is broader: it counts any specific factual data (dates, named studies, documented specifics) or verifiable citations (links, named sources, laws, publications), so a link or law citation with no numbers qualifies. Index 1 only counts specific numerical data or statistics, and non-quantitative examples score 0. A comment with a citation or named source but no figures gives 1 for index 0 and 0 for index 1. The two features have different eligibility rules, so they are not the same extraction function.
